# Spark Brake & Parts Cleaner

> Spark is a professional-strength, non-chlorinated, low VOC brake and parts cleaner in a 550 ml aerosol can. It removes brake fluid, grease, oil and dirt, dries fast and leaves no residue. It is supplied from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada to workshops, fleets, resellers and distributors across Ontario.

## Where we are and who we supply

- Based at 5925 Tomken Rd, Unit 11, Mississauga, ON L4W 4L8, Canada (Greater Toronto Area)
- Supplies: workshops, fleets, resellers and distributors in Ontario
- Phone: +1 (437) 988-0193
- Enquiries: form at https://sparkbrakeclean.com/contact (typical reply within two working days)
- There is no online checkout; supply and pricing are confirmed by enquiry

## Become a dealer or distributor

Distributor terms and bulk supply are available. To apply, send an enquiry choosing "Becoming a distributor" or call +1 (437) 988-0193. See https://sparkbrakeclean.com/become-a-dealer

## Key facts

- Product: brake & parts cleaner, aerosol, 550 ml
- Formulation: non-chlorinated, low VOC
- Residue: none; no wiping needed
- Compatibility: metals and most surfaces (test plastics, rubber and paint first)
- Uses: brake systems, clutch components, cars and light vehicles, trucks and fleets, machinery and tools
- Grade: professional and DIY
- Safety: extremely flammable; use in a well-ventilated area; keep away from heat, sparks and flame; never spray on hot surfaces; store below 50 °C
